author: /root/fixture_review
scope: Independent source review only. AST inspection is not unittest or actual process/signal execution.
conclusions: All allocations are per-test TemporaryDirectory children of the coordinated TMPDIR; current UID files/symlinks are synthetic and cleaned through registered test cleanup.
Real subprocess.Popen and signal.signal are forbidden by default; each process outcome uses explicit mocks. Import does not run a lane/native command.
Tests call actual packet main, manifest, ownership, per-command and finalization helpers rather than duplicating the production acceptance algorithm.
Fixed command allowlist permits only eight prior control entries and the exact new packet test command; it does not authorize native/Gradle entry points.
Launch failure, graceful timeout, recorded KILL escalation/external-cleanup limitation, shutdown failure, pending launch signals and isolated signal-handler branches have bounded synthetic coverage.
Original error plus failing postflight preserves results; preflight failure launches no child; success binds before/after manifests and all command results.
Root review finding corrected: source drift and nonzero child are now independent negative cases, each with the other acceptance condition valid, in separate owned test roots.
No application, simulator, ABI, callback, strict-protection or real OS process cleanup claim is conferred by these tests.
execution: NOT_EXECUTED_AT_REVIEW; coordinator will run in fixed manifest-bound packet
cleanup: Review only; no build/test/native worker or generated output allocated by reviewer.
